title: Why Do Computers Use Ones and Zeros?
hook: A tiny switch is easy to make on or off.
narration: A tiny switch is easy to make on or off.
This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do Computers Use Ones and Zeros.
On can mean one. Off can mean zero.
Let me show you that in 3D.
Billions of those switches make pictures and games.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
That is the quiet language of chips.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: A tiny switch is easy to make on or off.
The pictures today are a new circuit world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do computers use ones and zeros.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
